milestones.name: ATC Flight Plan Activated
rules: The check shall be performed to verify consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.
The AO must provide correct information before the first E-DPI message, to feed Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration, and first destination data.
The E-DPI message should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided.
For non coordinated airports, the flight plan is used to initiate the outbound flight.
The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT.
On Action on CDM Operation, ELDT and EIBT are updated for an arrival, and EOBT and ETOT are updated for a departure.
The DPI process commences the correct messaging with Network Operations if implemented.

milestones.name: EOBT - 2 hr
rules: Network Operations issues a CTOT at EOBT-2h if the flight is regulated.
The check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimated off block time at EOBT-2 hrs by checking whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.
Network Operations is informed at EOBT-2 hrs through the first T-DPI message about the updated take off time estimate.
For inbound flights, ELDT is updated based on information provided by the FUM messages, taking into account the actual progress of the flight.
Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT.
In the case of manual input of TOBT, this estimate overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.
On Action on CDM Operation, appropriate fields are marked as REGULATED.

milestones.name: Take Off from Outstation
rules: The outstation provides ATOT to the Network Operations and Aircraft Operator.
If the departure airport is more than 3hrs flying time from destination, ELDT is calculated using ATOT and the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL.
If the flight is within 3hrs flying time of the destination airport, Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS and sends a FUM that provides updates of the flight's progress.

The check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan at take off from outstation by checking whether the AO/GH estimated landing time is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.
A TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT using a T-DPI-t Message.
Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT.
In case EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT.
In the case where TOBT is available this prediction overrules the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

milestones.name: Local Radar Update
rules: The radar system detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when the flight crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary.
Update of ELDT can trigger a new TOBT to be entered by the AO/GH, or calculated automatically by the Airport CDM Platform.
Taking into account the taxi-in time (EXIT), any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30'.
An estimated in-block time (EIBT) is computed using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time.
This process commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.
Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.
The check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

milestones.name: Final Approach
rules: The radar system detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code and identifies when the flight crosses either a defined range/position or passes/leaves a predetermined level.
Update of the ELDT determines a new TOBT.
This process commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.
Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.
The check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.
other_concepts: parking marshal and ground handling services positioning

milestones.name: Landed
rules: ALDT is provided by ATC system or by ACARS from equipped aircraft.

The occurrence of ALDT triggers an update of TOBT and TTOT, updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the defined turn-round period for the departing flight.
The EIBT can be updated according to the ALDT+EXIT.
The check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, by checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.
Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.
On Action on CDM Operation, ELDT changes to ALDT, and EIBT, TOBT and TTOT are updated.

milestones.name: In-Block
rules: AIBT is provided by ACARS equipped aircraft or automated docking systems or ATC systems (e.g. A-SMGCS) or by manual input.

The occurrence of AIBT triggers an update of TOBT and TTOT, updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.
The check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, by checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.
Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.
On Action on CDM Operation, EIBT changes to AIBT and TOBT and TTOT are updated.
other_concepts: ACGT considered to commence at AIBT

milestones.name: Ground Handling Started
rules: Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides the ACGT information.

The occurrence of ACGT triggers an update of TOBT, updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.
The check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, by checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.
Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.
On Action on CDM Operation, ETTT/TOBT and TTOT are updated.
other_concepts: flights that are first operation of day or long term parked

milestones.name: Final Confirmation of the TOBT
rules: The Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides their most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation.

Following receipt of the TOBT, the ATC system will calculate and provide the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on the predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position.
The flight is introduced into the pre-departure sequence.
The check shall be performed by checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.
Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.
This check should be performed at a predefined time (local parameter) to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue and verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimates given the updated TOBT.
AO/GH check the quality of TOBT before TSAT issue.
No need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before.

milestones.name: TSAT Issued
rules: ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time (TSAT) t-minutes before EOBT, where t is a locally agreed parameter.
This process informs all relevant partners of the TSAT that has been allocated to the flight.
Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non regulated flights.
A check shall be performed to see whether the number of TOBT updates exceeds a tolerance defined locally, after TSAT has been issued.
In case the number of TOBT updates exceeds a threshold, then the TOBT input should be processed according to local procedure.
On Action on CDM Operation, TTOT is updated.

milestones.name: Boarding Starts
rules: This process informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs.
A check shall be performed at a certain time before TOBT (local variable) to check the boarding status and confirm whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT.
The AO/GH is informed in case TOBT needs to be updated.
other_concepts: air-bridge/pier, aircraft steps, coaching to stand

milestones.name: Aircraft Ready
rules: This process informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Ready Time (ARDT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft is ready for start up/push-back.
At TOBT+tolerance the AO/GH are informed that TOBT has passed and there has not been a ready status message yet.
ATC refines the pre-departure sequence.
The pilot requests start up just before TSAT, following coordination with the Ground Handler.

milestones.name: Start Up Requested
rules: ATC provides the Actual Start up Request Time (ASRT), based on pilot request.
This process informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASRT in the Airport CDM Platform.
This process alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start up has been requested inside the locally agreed TSAT tolerance window.
If the start up request is not made by TSAT+tolerance, the AO/GH is informed that no start up has been requested, and should update TOBT.
ATC confirms TSAT to the pilot in order to maintain the aircraft in the pre-departure sequence.
ATC assures that a regulated flight can respect its CTOT, provided the aircraft was ready on time (ARDT).

milestones.name: Start Up Approved
rules: ATC provides the Actual start up Approval Time (ASAT).
This process informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASAT in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has received start up approval/push-back clearance.
A check shall be performed to check if ASAT is in accordance to TSAT and to alert all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start up has been granted.
In case the start up approval is not granted at TSAT+tolerance, all relevant partners should be informed.
The flight will be re-sequenced.
other_concepts: start up request by flight crew (voice or DCL)

milestones.name: Off-Block
rules: AOBT is provided by ACARS equipped aircraft or automated docking systems or ATC systems (e.g. A-SMGCS) or by manual input.
This process informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has commenced push-back/taxi from parking position.
TTOT is updated considering the EXOT.
A check shall be performed to check if TTOT changes by more than the agreed tolerance and inform Network Operations.
AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations or, in the case of remote holding, at a defined time prior to TTOT.
After a first A-DPI is sent this check shall be performed to check TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.
On Action on CDM Operation, AOBT is recorded.

milestones.name: Take Off
rules: ATOT is provided by ATC system or from ACARS equipped aircraft.
This process informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off.
FSA and MVT messages are sent.
An airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence.
On Action on CDM Operation, ATOT is recorded.
